newsitem.title: USA: Franklin Quest acquires planner cos.
newsitem.headline: Franklin Quest acquires planner cos.

text.p: Franklin Quest Co said Tuesday it has acquired two related companies that provide academic and personal planners for students for about $23 million in cash.
The two companies, Premier Agendas Inc based in Bellingham, Wash., and Premier School Agendas Ltd of Abbotsford, British Columbia, provide the planners in the U.S. and Canada.
Franklin Quest said it also may make additional payments based on Premier's operating performance during the three years following the acquisition.

Their combined annual revenues were about $35 million for the year ended December 31. Franklin Quest posted net income of $34.24 million, or $1.53 per share, on sales of $332 million in the 1996 fiscal year.
Franklin Quest provides training seminars and products.
